sourceInstrument.description: The managed account from which funds will be collected.

transferAmount.description: The amount, in same currency as source and destination, that was transferred from the source.

purpose.description: The purpose of the payment. Mandatory for wire transfers executed over `SWIFT`.

description.description:
These details are passed to the beneficiary as the `reference` . This field is mandatory for wire transfers executed over `SEPA`and `SWIFT`. The allowed length is dependent on the payment type:

`SEPA` <= `35` characters. An extended character set is accepted to cater for all European languages. If `SEPA` does not support a particular character, it is automatically converted to an acceptable alternative, in line with `SEPA` scheme guidance.

`SWIFT` <= `35` characters

`Faster Payments` <= `18` characters

Currency.description: The currency expressed in ISO-4217 code. Example: GBP, EUR, USD.

amount.description:
The monetary amount, scaled to the lowest denomination of the currency.

Example, an amount of 1000 for a EUR currency is actually 1000 Euro cents or EUR 10.00.

CurrencyAmount.description: The object representing a monetary amount in a particular currency.

DateOfBirth.description: The date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

ExternalAccountId.description: The id of an external account, such as a Linked Account, registered with the Weavr Platform.

FasterPaymentsBankDetailsOrBACSBankDetai.description: Bank details used in case the wire transfer is executed over Faster Payments.

accountNumber.description: Account number, required for wire transfer over Faster Payments.

sortCode.description: Sort code, required for wire transfer over Faster Payments.

FasterPaymentsBeneficiary.description: Beneficiary details for Faster Payments wire transfers.

name.description:
The beneficiary's full name. >= 1 character and <= 140 characters.
Note: the ' symbol is the unicode value U+2019 (right single quotation mark)
and not the unicode value U+0027 (apostrophe).

type.description: The type of beneficiary account. Required for Faster Payments.

accountNumber.description: Account number, required for wire transfer over Faster Payments.

sortCode.description: Sort code, required for wire transfer over Faster Payments.

secondaryReference.description: Optional secondary reference for accounts without unique sort codes.

bankCountry.description: The beneficiary's bank country in ISO 3166 alpha-2 format.

IBANDetails.description: Bank details used in case the wire transfer is executed over SEPA or RIX

iban.description: International Bank Account Number, required for wire transfer over SEPA or RIX

bankIdentifierCode.description: BIC, for wire transfer over SEPA or RIX

Nationality.description: Nationality of the user - using ISO 3166 alpha-2.

OutgoingWireTransferBeneficiary.description:
Details of the beneficiary of the outgoing wire transfer.
**Deprecated**: Use `SEPABeneficiary` for SEPA/IBAN transfers or `FasterPaymentsBeneficiary` for Faster Payments transfers instead.

name.description:
The beneficiary's full name. The allowed length and pattern is dependent on the bank account details type:

`IBANDetails`: >= `1` character and <= `150` characters. An extended character set is accepted to cater for all European languages. If `SEPA` does not support a particular character, it is automatically converted to an acceptable alternative, in line with `SEPA` scheme guidance.

`FasterPaymentsBankDetailsOrBACSBankDetails`: >= `1` character and <= `140` characters with a pattern of `^[a-zA-Z0-9\/\-?:().,’+\s#=!"%&*<>;\{@\r\n]*$`
(please note that the `’` symbol is the unicode value U+2019 (right single quotation mark) and not the unicode value U+0027 (apostrophe))

type.description: The type of beneficiary account. Required only when `FasterPaymentsBankDetailsOrBACSBankDetails` are specified

address.description: The beneficiary’s address. For `SEPA`, an extended character set is accepted to cater for all European languages. If `SEPA` does not support a particular character, it is automatically converted to an acceptable alternative, in line with `SEPA` scheme guidance.

bankCountry.description: The beneficiary's bank country in ISO 3166 alpha-2 format.

bankAccountDetails.description: Details of the beneficiary bank account, depending on the type of transfer chosen.

ProfileId.description:
The profile Id which a specific identity, instrument or transaction type is linked to.

Profiles contain configuration and determine behavioral aspects of the newly created transaction, for example, fees that may apply.

You can have one or more profiles linked to your application, and these can be used to drive different behaviors according to your product's needs.

Profile Ids can be found in the Multi Portal, in the API Credentials page.

RIXBeneficiary.description: Beneficiary details for RIX wire transfers.

name.description:
The beneficiary's full name. >= 1 character and <= 150 characters.
An extended character set is accepted to cater for all European languages.
If RIX does not support a particular character, it is automatically
converted to an acceptable alternative.

iban.description: International Bank Account Number, required for wire transfer over RIX.

bankIdentifierCode.description: BIC (Bank Identifier Code) for wire transfer over RIX.

bankCountry.description: The beneficiary's bank country in ISO 3166 alpha-2 format.

SEPABeneficiary.description: Beneficiary details for SEPA/IBAN wire transfers.

name.description:
The beneficiary's full name. >= 1 character and <= 150 characters.
An extended character set is accepted to cater for all European languages.
If SEPA does not support a particular character, it is automatically
converted to an acceptable alternative, in line with SEPA scheme guidance.

iban.description: International Bank Account Number, required for wire transfer over SEPA.

bankIdentifierCode.description: BIC (Bank Identifier Code) for wire transfer over SEPA.

SWIFTBeneficiary.description: Beneficiary details for SWIFT wire transfers.

account.description: Can be either an account number or an International Bank Account Number (IBAN).

bankIdentifierCode.description: Required if account is not an IBAN. Bank Identifier Code (BIC).

bankCountry.description: The beneficiary's bank country in ISO 3166 alpha-2 format.

ScheduledTimestamp.description: The epoch timestamp at which the transaction is scheduled to be executed.

Tag.description: The tag field is a custom field that can be used to search and filter.
